description: This file contains the PHP source code for the `Language` class within the `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Event` namespace. It defines a controller that manages language variables during the request lifecycle, including methods for handling index, before, and after events related to language data management.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing language variables during different event phases such as index, before, and after. It handles dumping language variables into templates, saving current language data before controller load, and restoring language data after controller execution.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that dumps all language variables into the template, integrating language data with route parameters.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Event handler that stores current language data into a backup before the controller loads new data.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Event handler that restores language data from a backup after controller execution completes.
